name: Cloud sign-in offers Google and email, pairing belongs to desktop

planSteps.description: Open https://muster.orazen.online/app and wait for redirect to the sign-in screen
A 'Continue with Google' button is visible
An email textbox and a password textbox are visible with a 'Sign in with email' button
A 'New here? Create an account' button is present
Submit the sign-in form with a wrong email like nobody-nobody@example.com and a wrong 16-character password
An error message is shown and the user is not signed in
